description.value: Northern Rockies Lodge is a full-service resort on the shores of Muncho Lake at Mile 462 of the Alaska Highway, roughly halfway between Whitehorse and Fort St. John — making it a rare concentration of services in one of northern BC's most remote corridors. The property spans hotel rooms, motel units, cabins, lakeshore chalets, an RV park, a fully licensed dining room and lounge, sauna, and an on-site gas station. It also serves as the base for floatplane-accessed backcountry fishing expeditions into the Muskwa-Kechika wilderness.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the lodge is open year-round at Mile 462 Alaska Highway, Muncho Lake, BC, matching the OSM address and phone (+1-250-776-3481). Laundry facilities are confirmed from the /rvpark subpage ('coin shower, laundry facilities'), and Wi-Fi is confirmed both in OSM (internet_access=wlan) and the /rvpark page ('WIFI' listed for all RV site tiers). concerns: OSM lists email as info@northernrockieslodge.com but the /terms page directs cancellations to info@nrlodge.com — both may be active aliases but worth noting.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, year-round full-service lodge with accommodation, dining, RV camping, and fuel in one of the most isolated stretches of the Alaska Highway — highly valuable to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: On-site gas station noted; cyclists can refuel here in a stretch with very few services. Lodge operates on Pacific Daylight Time in summer and Mountain Time in winter per the /terms page.
